items.title_zh: 英伟达开放 Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B 生图 AI 模型权重：某些跑分超 GPT Image 2
items.title_en: Nvidia opens weights for Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B image-generation model, topping GPT Image 2 on some benchmarks
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，科技媒体 Wccftech 今天（11 月 25 日）发布博文，报道称英伟达在 Hugging Face 平台悄然公开了 Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B 模型的权重。该模型采用混合专家架构，总参数达 300 亿，使用时激活 30 亿参数，对本地硬件更友好。 Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B 是一款自回归图像生成模型，也是该公司新框架 Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation 的核心光栅渲染引擎。该框架秉持“像素即代码”（Pixel as Code）的理念，不仅能生成富有表现力的图片，还能产出可编辑的视觉成果，包括网页、幻灯片、文档、图表和科学插图等。 Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B 基于 Nemotron 3 Nano 打造，沿用 Nemotron-H 混合设计，结合 Mamba-2 状态空间层与传统注意力机制，并经过渐进式中期训练和组相对策略优化（GRPO）。 跑分方面，在考察密集文字生成准确率的 LongTextBench 上，该模型得分 97.98，高于 GPT Image 2 的 96.00 和 Nano Banana Pro 的 97.60。 在 GenEval 上，它以 92.86 领先 GPT Image 2 的 89.00。此外，它还在 CVTG-2K（92.53）、WISE Verified（91.50）和 BizGenEval（86.0）中拿到最高分。 不过在 GenEval2 上，GPT Image 2 以 81.00 对 65.43 占优。在 Qwen-Image-Bench 上，GPT Image 2 以 65.23 对 52.46 领先。 基准测试 ↑ Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation GPT Image 2 Nano Banana Pro GenEval 92.86 89.00 — GenEval2 65.43 81.00 59.00 UniGenBench++ 短提示版 93.20 — 92.72 UniGenBench++ 长提示版 94.25 — 94.20 LongTextBench（长文本基准） 97.98 96.00 97.60 CVTG-2K 92.53 90.03 77.90 OneIG 54.63 51.60 58.30 Qwen-Image-Bench 52.46 65.23 59.33 WISE Verified 91.50 — 87.60 BizGenEval 86.0 83.2 76.7 IT之家附上参考地址 Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation
items.summary_en: According to IT Home on November 25, Wccftech reported that Nvidia quietly published the weights of Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B on Hugging Face. The model uses a mixture-of-experts architecture with 30 billion total parameters and 3 billion active parameters, making it more friendly to local hardware. It is an autoregressive image-generation model and the core raster rendering engine of Nvidia's new Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation framework. The framework follows a “Pixel as Code” concept and can produce not only expressive images but also editable visual outputs, including webpages, slides, documents, charts and scientific illustrations. The model is built on Nemotron 3 Nano, follows the Nemotron-H hybrid design combining Mamba-2 state-space layers with traditional attention, and underwent progressive mid-training and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). On benchmarks, it scored 97.98 on LongTextBench, above GPT Image 2's 96.00 and Nano Banana Pro's 97.60; it led GPT Image 2 on GenEval with 92.86 versus 89.00; however, GPT Image 2 led on GenEval2 with 81.00 versus 65.43 and on Qwen-Image-Bench with 65.23 versus 52.46.
items.why_zh: 推测：若这些基准结果可复现，开源且激活参数较低的图像模型可能降低本地部署门槛，并加剧与闭源模型的竞争；尚待独立验证。
items.why_en: Speculative: if these benchmark results are reproducible, an open-weight image model with low active parameters could lower local deployment barriers and intensify competition with closed models; independent verification is pending.

items.title_zh: 态度反转：消息称亚马逊与 Meta 洽谈合作，或将开放商城给 Muse AI 购物助手
items.title_en: Reversal reported: Amazon and Meta in talks to let Muse AI shopping assistant access Amazon marketplace
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，有消息显示，亚马逊对 Meta 旗下 AI 智能体 Muse 的态度或许正在转变。两大巨头正在洽谈一项合作，希望让 Muse 直接接入亚马逊电商平台。 IT之家注意到，这次谈判和两个月前的局面形成鲜明反差：当时用户尝试通过 Muse 在亚马逊下单结账时，会直接收到报错，亚马逊对 Muse 实施了屏蔽。 《财富》当地时间周三援引知情人士报道，双方已经开展多轮磋商。目前谈判卡在两个核心议题：合作模式下商品搜索结果如何展示、广告业务怎么安排。 亚马逊最大的顾虑，是 Muse 这类第三方购物智能体会冲击自身广告收入。今年 10 月，亚马逊 CEO 安迪 · 贾西还表态，通过外部 AI 智能体下单的用户规模并不大。 另一个考量是，亚马逊可能打算等 Muse 产品更加成熟之后再开放接入。如果 Muse 下错订单、交易出问题，最终需要亚马逊去安抚不满的消费者和卖家。 知情人士称，亚马逊高管还担心，第三方 AI 购物智能体会削弱亚马逊直接触达用户、维系消费者关系的能力。报道同时提到，这份潜在合作协议，最终需要两家公司 CEO 批准才能落地。
items.summary_en: According to IT Home on November 25, reports suggest Amazon's attitude toward Meta's AI agent Muse may be changing. The two giants are in talks on a partnership that would let Muse connect directly to Amazon's e-commerce platform. The talks contrast sharply with the situation two months ago, when users trying to check out on Amazon through Muse received an error and Amazon blocked Muse. Fortune reported on Wednesday local time, citing people familiar with the matter, that the two sides have held multiple rounds of discussions. The talks are currently stuck on two core issues: how product search results would be displayed under the partnership model, and how the advertising business would be arranged. Amazon's biggest concern is that third-party shopping agents like Muse could hurt its advertising revenue. In October this year, Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said the number of users placing orders through external AI agents was not large. Another consideration is that Amazon may intend to wait until Muse is more mature before opening access. If Muse places wrong orders or transactions go wrong, Amazon would ultimately need to reassure dissatisfied consumers and sellers. People familiar with the matter said Amazon executives are also worried that third-party AI shopping agents would weaken Amazon's ability to reach users directly and maintain consumer relationships. The report also said the potential partnership would ultimately need approval from the CEOs of both companies.
items.why_zh: 推测：若达成，可能改变 AI 购物助手与电商平台的接入规则和广告模式；谈判仍可能失败，且报道未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculative: if reached, the deal could change access rules and advertising models between AI shopping assistants and e-commerce platforms; the talks could still fail, and the report has not been officially confirmed.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，亚马逊预计今年资本开支将达到约 2,200 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.47 万亿元人民币） ，创下历史纪录，资金主要投向 AWS 以及人工智能基础设施。 AWS 首席财务官约翰 · 费尔顿（John Felton）在接受 Business Insider 邮件采访时表示，公司会提前锁定土地、电力、审批这类建设周期漫长的资源，而服务器等设备采购则延后，等客户订单给出更明确的需求信号再出手。 他说：“我们争取在合适的最晚时点做出正确决策。” 他也解释了 AWS 的判断：在 AI 领域， 行动太慢带来的风险，高于大手笔投入的风险。 “速度是一种选择，”他说， “放到 AI 这件事上，我的答案就是要加快节奏。” 费尔顿在转入 AWS 之前，在亚马逊零售业务的财务和运营岗位任职约二十年。采访中他谈及 AWS 如何权衡 AI 算力规模与投资回报、从疫情期间物流扩张中吸取的经验，以及自己的职业经历。 下面是经过小幅润色整理的问答内容： 问：当亚马逊判断是提前备货建设，还是暂缓投入时，遵循哪些原则？ 答：我们依据看得见的客户需求来建设，客户的长期订单决定我们的建设规模。土地、电力、审批流程要耗时数年，所以这部分我们提前敲定。其余可以延后采购的设备，我们都会延后采购，等待更多信息，保留选择空间。 我们尽可能依托充足数据，在负责任的最晚节点做判断。如果需求没有落地，我们就不下采购订单。 问：过去多轮扩张周期里，在信息有限的情况下分配资本预算，你收获了哪些经验？ 答：我们认识到不存在完美的预测。所以要针对多种情景制定方案，并随外部变化持续调整。疫情期间，消费者和卖家都依赖我们，于是我们快速扩建。这段经历让我们找到了优化方向，把物流网络按区域重构，降低了履约成本，也提升了配送时效。 放到 AWS 这边，土地、电力这类长期资产通用性强、可以长期复用，我们愿意提前锁定。其余设备等客户确认订单后再采购，之后持续跟踪待交付订单，动态调整。 问：如何形容亚马逊当前这一轮基建投资的体量？本轮扩张和以往有什么不同？ 答：这次投资规模巨大，因为对应的市场机会同样巨大。AI 技术的迭代速度超过我们过往见过的任何技术，行业仍然处在早期阶段。 客户持续下长期订单、需求增长速度快于我们的装机速度，这些信号证明这笔投资具备合理性。我们同时也看到营收增长、利润率和回报表现向好。AWS 刚起步的时候，没人确定客户会不会使用它。现在客户会签下多年合约，需求来自数百万客户，我们对未来需求的判断更加清晰。 我们始终关注客户当下以及未来的需求，当年搭建履约中心、拓展末端配送网络也是这套思路。我们会优先偏向满足客户。 问：支撑 AWS 资本开支计划的核心假设与取舍是什么？ 答：我们会做出很多假设，但并不认为需要被迫取舍。我们的目标是从长期角度为客户做正确的选择，不用在多个目标之间二选一。我们假设客户会持续和我们一起增长，并且以客户多年期订单作为规划基准。我们也假设建成的资产可以长期产生收益，回报会在多年周期里逐步兑现。 AI 赛道慢一步的代价，比之前几次技术转型都更高，所以我们选择提速。投资跟着需求走，目标是匹配需求规模。 问：除客户需求之外，电力供给、审批、社区沟通、宏观政策环境，会如何影响 AWS 新增数据中心的选址和节奏？ 答：约束条件从来不止一项，并且一直在变化。电力、审批、芯片、内存、网络与光模块都是制约因素，一个问题刚解决，下一个瓶颈就会出现。我们要提前预判风险、主动应对。 社区沟通从规划阶段就纳入考量。我们会和地方政府、居民沟通，尽力保证数据中心落地之后，当地社区能够获益。 问：近期选举结果是否改变了你们的开支假设？ 答：我们和每一届执政团队保持沟通，争取建立良性合作关系，为员工、客户和业务发声。自亚马逊成立以来，无论哪个政党执政，我们的策略都没有变：聚焦客户、坚持创新、着眼长期。这一点不会改变，我们的规划始终跟着客户需求走。 问：你们用哪些指标判断 AWS 的 AI 投资能否带来可观回报？ 答：首要指标就是客户是否下达长期订单，这代表需求真实存在。截至 2026 年第三季度，我们的待交付订单规模达到 5,780 亿美元 （现汇率约合 3.86 万亿元人民币） ，增速为三位数，覆盖各行各业、各种规模的客户。其次看投资能否回本、营收增速和利…
items.summary_en: According to IT Home on November 25, Amazon expects capital expenditure this year to reach about $220 billion (about RMB 1.47 trillion), a record high, mainly directed to AWS and AI infrastructure. In an email interview with Business Insider, AWS CFO John Felton said the company locks in long-lead resources such as land, power and approvals in advance, while delaying purchases of servers and other equipment until customer orders provide clearer demand signals. “We try to make the right decision at the latest appropriate time,” he said. He also explained AWS's judgment: in AI, the risk of moving too slowly is higher than the risk of large spending. “Speed is a choice,” he said. “On AI, my answer is to pick up the pace.” Felton also discussed how AWS decides build scale based on long-term customer orders, plans for multiple scenarios, lessons from pandemic-era logistics expansion, and constraints including power, approvals, chips, memory, networking and optical modules. As of the third quarter of 2026, AWS's backlog reached $578 billion (about RMB 3.86 trillion), growing at a triple-digit rate.
items.why_zh: 推测：这一创纪录开支反映云厂商对 AI 算力需求的押注，可能影响其短期利润与行业供给节奏；报道基于公司高管采访。
items.why_en: Speculative: this record spending reflects cloud providers' bet on AI compute demand and could affect short-term profits and industry supply节奏; the report is based on an interview with a company executive.

items.summary_zh: AI is straining America’s open records systems MIT Technology Review
items.summary_en: In Panton, Vermont, population 660, town clerk Kyle Rowe did it all. He crafted budgets, paid vendors, handled property tax disputes, and served as the town’s zoning supervisor and presiding elections officer. During morning office hours at the town hall—a wood-frame structure built as a church in 1858—he also fielded public records requests. Recently, he got rather busy. Panton used to get a request every year or so from a company called SmartProcure for “all purchasing records,” covering everything from road salt to computers to toilet paper. Last year, those requests started coming quarterly. Then different companies began making more specific requests, like records of every purchase related to emergency road flares. These targeted inquiries started coming monthly or more. “I’m happy to answer public records requests from people,” says Rowe, who recently moved into a position at a nearby town. “But answering it for these purposes—it feels like I’m doing unpaid opposition research on the taxpayers’ time.” Rowe’s experiences are being repeated across the US. While data brokers have mined public records for decades, AI has intensified investors’ interest. Over the last few years, venture-backed startups have raised upwards of $100 million to collect data from thousands of agencies and turn it into AI-powered “signals” that help businesses sell to governments. At the same time, AI tools have made it easier for individuals to draft public records requests. Many places have seen double-digit annual increases in recent years. While more activity is good for democracy, AI-drafted requests tend to be longer, and broader in scope—and the offices answering them haven’t always grown in head count or budget. items.title_zh: 何小鹏：机器人产业规模将超汽车，关键是做出高等级机器人、跑通商业模型
items.title_en: He Xiaopeng: robotics industry will surpass autos; key is high-level robots and a viable business model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据新浪科技报道，今日 2026 小鹏科技日结束后，小鹏集团董事长、CEO 何小鹏与小鹏集团副董事长、总裁顾宏地共同出席媒体对话环节。围绕机器人业务的发展前景，何小鹏给出了“长期极度乐观、短期保持审慎”的判断。 何小鹏表示，从中长期来看，机器人产业的规模“毋庸置疑”，一定会成为世界上超过汽车的最大产业。 不过，何小鹏也清醒地指出了当前行业面临的现实挑战。他表示，现阶段很多机器人的销量并不大，全球机器人市场可能仅有几万台规模。问题的核心在于何时能够造出高等级的机器人：如果消费者购买一台机器人后，还需要配备大量人力为其提供服务，且机器人只能完成少量任务，那么投资回报率（ROI）将完全无法成立，商业模型也就跑不通。 IT之家注意到，何小鹏进一步展望，一旦商业模型能够跑通，无论是商业、工业、农业还是家庭服务业，机器人都将面临无限制的需求。他强调，企业无需贪多求全去覆盖众多行业，只需将某一个方向做深做透，就能释放出巨大的想象力和发展空间。
items.summary_en: According to IT Home on November 25, Sina Tech reported that after the 2026 XPeng Tech Day, XPeng Group Chairman and CEO He Xiaopeng and XPeng Group Vice Chairman and President Gu Hongdi attended a media dialogue. On the prospects of the robotics business, He Xiaopeng gave a judgment of “extremely optimistic in the long term and cautious in the short term.” He said that in the medium and long term, the scale of the robotics industry is “beyond doubt” and will definitely become the world's largest industry, surpassing automobiles. However, he also pointed out current challenges: many robots do not sell in large volumes at this stage, and the global robot market may be only tens of thousands of units. The core question is when high-level robots can be built: if a consumer buys a robot but still needs a large amount of manpower to provide services for it, and the robot can only complete a small number of tasks, then ROI will be completely unviable and the business model will not work. He further looked ahead that once the business model works, robots will face unlimited demand in commerce, industry, agriculture and home services. He emphasized that companies do not need to cover many industries; deeply mastering one direction can unleash huge imagination and development space.
items.why_zh: 推测：若机器人商业模型跑通，可能带来比汽车更大的产业空间；但当前市场规模和 ROI 仍是短期制约，属于高管判断。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the robotics business model works, it could create an industry space larger than automobiles; however, current market size and ROI remain short-term constraints, and this is an executive's judgment.

items.title_zh: 京东物流发布行业首个 F2B2C 冷链全场景解决方案，服务覆盖超 340 个城市、超 80% 订单当日 / 次日达
items.title_en: JD Logistics Launches Industry-First F2B2C Full-Scenario Cold-Chain Solution, Covering 340+ Cities
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，京东物流今日发布行业首个 F2B2C（工厂 / 产地到商家 / 渠道到消费者）冷链全场景解决方案，打造全链路智能化、低碳化的冷链供应链网络。 据介绍，京东物流的高品质冷链服务已经 覆盖全国超 340 个城市 ，超过 80% 冷链订单可实现当日、次日达。 IT之家获悉，截至目前，京东物流已在全国运营超过 60 个生鲜、冷冻、冷藏食品温控冷链仓库，总管理面积超 40 万平方米；同时布局医药专仓体系，运营 60 余个药品、医疗企业专用仓库，总管理面积超 60 万平方米。 此外，京东物流成都冷链“智狼”仓今日正式开仓， 这是行业首个落地低温“智狼”系统的自动化冷链仓库 ，在 -20℃ 低温环境下，机器人也可稳定穿梭作业，生鲜冻品从拣选到出库最快仅十余分钟。仓库投用后，冷链商品在四川及周边省份的 36 个城市均可实现最快当日、次日送达。 官方表示，在 -18℃ 冷冻库区，京东物流部署数十台低温版“智狼”机器人，他们在近 8 米高货架、超 40000 个储位之间自主穿梭，完成商品搬运与拣选，推动库区作业效率提升超 3 倍。 京东物流低温版“智狼”机器人采用抗低温材料、自研低温控制器，并匹配自纠偏算法，应用非接触式无线供电、环境主动防御等技术，保障设备在低温环境持续稳定运行。
items.summary_en: IT之家, November 25: JD Logistics today released the industry's first F2B2C (factory/origin to merchant/channel to consumer) full-scenario cold-chain solution, building a full-link intelligent and low-carbon cold-chain supply network. According to the company, its high-quality cold-chain services already cover more than 340 cities nationwide, and over 80% of cold-chain orders can be delivered same-day or next-day. IT之家 notes that JD Logistics currently operates more than 60 temperature-controlled cold-chain warehouses for fresh, frozen and refrigerated food nationwide, with total managed area exceeding 400,000 square meters; it also runs a dedicated pharmaceutical warehouse system with more than 60 warehouses dedicated to pharmaceutical and medical companies, totaling over 600,000 square meters. In addition, JD Logistics' Chengdu cold-chain "Zhilang" warehouse officially opened today; it is the industry's first automated cold-chain warehouse deploying the "Zhilang" system at low temperatures, where robots can operate stably at -20°C, and fresh frozen goods go from picking to outbound in as little as just over ten minutes. Once the warehouse is in use, cold-chain goods in 36 cities in Sichuan and neighboring provinces can be delivered same-day or next-day at the fastest. The company says that in the -18°C freezer zone, JD Logistics has deployed dozens of low-temperature "Zhilang" robots that move autonomously among shelves nearly 8 meters high and more than 40,000 storage locations to move and pick goods, raising warehouse operating efficiency by more than 3 times. The low-temperature "Zhilang" robots use low-temperature-resistant materials, self-developed low-temperature controllers and self-correcting algorithms, plus contactless wireless power supply and active environmental defense technologies, to ensure stable operation in low-temperature environments.
items.why_zh: 推测：低温自动化仓的落地显示冷链物流正加速以机器人替代低温人工搬运，实际效率与成本效果仍需运营数据验证。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，京东物流今日发布行业首个 F2B2C（工厂 / 产地到商家 / 渠道到消费者）冷链全场景解决方案，打造全链路智能化、低碳化的冷链供应链网络。 据介绍，京东物流的高品质冷链服务已经 覆盖全国超 340 个城市 ，超过 80% 冷链订单可实现当日、次日达。 IT之家获悉，截至目前，京东物流已在全国运营超过 60 个生鲜、冷冻、冷藏食品温控冷链仓库，总管理面积超 40 万平方米；同时布局医药专仓体系，运营 60 余个药品、医疗企业专用仓库，总管理面积超 60 万平方米。 此外，京东物流成都冷链“智狼”仓今日正式开仓， 这是行业首个落地低温“智狼”系统的自动化冷链仓库 ，在 -20℃ 低温环境下，机器人也可稳定穿梭作业，生鲜冻品从拣选到出库最快仅十余分钟。仓库投用后，冷链商品在四川及周边省份的 36 个城市均可实现最快当日、次日送达。 官方表示，在 -18℃ 冷冻库区，京东物流部署数十台低温版“智狼”机器人，他们在近 8 米高货架、超 40000 个储位之间自主穿梭，完成商品搬运与拣选，推动库区作业效率提升超 3 倍。 京东物流低温版“智狼”机器人采用抗低温材料、自研低温控制器，并匹配自纠偏算法，应用非接触式无线供电、环境主动防御等技术，保障设备在低温环境持续稳定运行。

items.title_en: Report: Stripe valuation could top $200 billion in new share buyback
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，《华尔街日报》当地时间昨日报道称，支付技术企业 Stripe 正在讨论新一轮的年度例行股票回购计划。 该企业的估值有望在本轮回购中突破 2,000 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.34 万亿元人民币） 。 按照惯例， Stripe 将在新年初正式宣布回购计划 ，便于员工套现持股。知情人士透露，此次回购的出资方除 Stripe 自身外很可能还包括现有投资者。 Stripe 正积极涉足人工智能领域 ：该企业今年 8 月以超 70 亿美元收购 OpenRouter，并将自身技术栈与智能体消费市场整合。Stripe 还并购了软件按用量计费初创企业 Metronome、小企业贷款平台 Parafin。 参考 https://www.wsj.com/business/stripes-valuation-set-to-top-200-billion-in-latest-investor-talks-122c9027
items.summary_en: ITHome, Nov 25: The Wall Street Journal reported locally yesterday that payments technology company Stripe is discussing a new annual routine share buyback plan, with its valuation potentially topping $200 billion in this round (ITHome note: about RMB 1.34 trillion at current exchange rates). As usual, Stripe will formally announce the buyback in early next year to let employees cash out shares. People familiar with the matter said the buyback is likely to be funded by Stripe itself and possibly existing investors. Stripe is actively moving into AI: in August this year it acquired OpenRouter for more than $7 billion and integrated its tech stack with the agent consumer market. Stripe also acquired usage-based billing software startup Metronome and small-business lending platform Parafin.

items.title_zh: Counterpoint：2026 年 Q3 全球纯晶圆代工市场同比增长 36%，台积电份额扩大至 75%
items.title_en: Counterpoint: Global pure-play foundry market grows 36% YoY in Q3 2026; TSMC share rises to 75%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，Counterpoint 今日发布数据显示，2026 年第三季度， 纯晶圆代工行业同比增长 36%，环比增长 13% ，原因是人工智能对先进制程和先进封装的需求持续超过供给，同时晶圆价格上涨进一步推高了营收。 其中， 台积电在纯晶圆代工市场的份额扩大至 75% ，高于前两个季度各 73% 的水平，营收环比增长 16%。驱动因素包括 2 纳米制程持续放量、N3 产能满载以及 CoWoS 产能持续扩张。 三星代工位居第二，但其份额从 2026 年第二季度的 6.9% 下滑至 6.4%，因为其营收增长（环比 +6%）落后于整体市场。提高 SF2 良率仍是赢得先进制程订单的关键。 中芯国际凭借又一个创纪录的季度营收（环比增长 6%）保住了第三的位置，这得益于强劲的本地需求以及从海外转移过来的订单。 展望未来，Counterpoint 预计，得益于晶圆平均售价的上涨以及先进封装产能的进一步扩张，纯晶圆代工厂的产能利用率将在 2026 年第四季度至 2027 年期间保持高位。
items.summary_en: ITHome Nov 25: Counterpoint data released today shows that in Q3 2026 the pure-play wafer foundry industry grew 36% YoY and 13% QoQ, as AI demand for advanced process nodes and advanced packaging continued to exceed supply, while rising wafer prices further boosted revenue. TSMC's share of the pure-play foundry market expanded to 75%, up from 73% in each of the previous two quarters, with revenue up 16% QoQ. Drivers include continued 2nm ramp-up, fully loaded N3 capacity, and continued CoWoS capacity expansion. Samsung Foundry ranked second, but its share fell from 6.9% in Q2 2026 to 6.4%, as its revenue growth (+6% QoQ) lagged the overall market. Improving SF2 yield remains key to winning advanced-node orders. SMIC retained third place with another record quarterly revenue (+6% QoQ), thanks to strong local demand and orders shifted from overseas. Looking ahead, Counterpoint expects pure-play foundry utilization to remain high from Q4 2026 through 2027, supported by rising wafer average selling prices and further expansion of advanced packaging capacity.
items.why_zh: 这显示 AI 需求可能正在持续重塑晶圆代工格局并强化台积电主导地位；但数据来自 Counterpoint 单一机构报告，仍需其他来源交叉验证。
items.why_en: This suggests AI demand may be continuing to reshape the foundry landscape and strengthen TSMC's dominance; however, the data comes from a single Counterpoint report and still needs cross-validation from other sources.

items.title_en: Tesla FSD EU approval meeting postponed to December 15
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据路透社报道，欧盟委员会一名发言人当地时间周三证实，原本将审议特斯拉自动驾驶辅助系统（FSD）在全欧盟获批申请的会议，推迟至 12 月 15 日举行。 IT之家注意到，今年 4 月荷兰先行给出初步批准后，机动车技术委员会（TCMV）前两次会议都没有安排投票，外界原本期待其能在 12 月的会议上对这套系统进行表决。 这场投票是特斯拉把该技术推向整个欧盟市场的关键关卡。目前已经有近十多个国家跟进荷兰的审批，其中人口最多的意大利已经落地启用。但想要拿到欧盟全境许可，需要 27 个成员国里至少 15 国投赞成票，且这些国家人口合计占欧盟总人口 65% 以上。 荷兰监管机构 RDW 透露，本次会议原定 12 月 1 日召开。比利时弗拉芒大区交通部早先称会议改到 12 月 7 日，之后欧盟委员会澄清，最终时间定为 12 月 15 日。
items.summary_en: ITHome Nov 25: According to Reuters, a European Commission spokesperson confirmed on Wednesday local time that the meeting originally scheduled to review Tesla's application for EU-wide approval of its Full Self-Driving (FSD) driver-assistance system has been postponed to December 15. ITHome notes that after the Netherlands gave preliminary approval in April this year, the first two meetings of the Technical Committee on Motor Vehicles (TCMV) did not schedule a vote; the outside world had expected it to vote on the system at the December meeting. The vote is a key hurdle for Tesla to bring the technology to the entire EU market. More than ten countries have followed the Netherlands' approval, including the most populous, Italy, where it has already been enabled. But to obtain EU-wide authorization, at least 15 of the 27 member states must vote in favor, and those countries must together account for more than 65% of the EU's total population. Dutch regulator RDW said the meeting was originally scheduled for December 1. Belgium's Flanders transport department earlier said it had been moved to December 7; the European Commission later clarified that the final date is December 15.
items.why_zh: 若后续投票通过，这可能是特斯拉 FSD 在欧盟全境落地的关键一步；但目前只是会议推迟，审批结果仍不确定。
items.why_en: If the subsequent vote passes, it could be a key step for Tesla FSD to be deployed across the EU; however, for now only the meeting has been postponed, and the approval outcome remains uncertain.

items.title_zh: SK 海力士计划 4 至 5 年内量产 3D DRAM，首款产品采用 100 层堆叠
items.title_en: SK hynix aims to mass-produce 3D DRAM in 4–5 years; first product to use 100-layer stacking
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据 The Elec 报道，SK 海力士资深工程师崔康植（Choi Kang-sik）在首尔大学 AI 半导体论坛上透露，公司目标在 4 至 5 年内实现 3D DRAM 量产，首款商用产品将采用 100 层垂直堆叠存储单元。 他介绍，想要达到当前 10nm 级 DRAM 同等密度，大约需要 75 层存储单元；综合其他设计考量，第一款量产产品直接定为 100 层。现有设备可以支撑 100 层方案的制造，但如果后续要做到 200 层、300 层甚至更高堆叠，就需要专用新设备。长期规划上，SK 海力士计划借鉴 3D NAND 的多层堆叠与混合键合技术，冲击 1000 层以上。 目前 SK 海力士已经完成 3D DRAM 存储单元样片制造，并且验证了器件工作特性，刷新性能可以对标传统 DRAM。3D DRAM 是存储单元垂直堆叠的全新架构，和 HBM（多颗 DRAM 裸片堆叠）、DRAM 叠在逻辑芯片上的 3D 堆叠方案不是一回事。 据IT之家了解，传统平面 DRAM 微缩已经逼近物理瓶颈：依靠电容存电，单元尺寸越小，储电量越低、漏电流和电阻上升。3D DRAM 不再一味缩小平面尺寸，改用垂直堆叠提升密度，以此解决电容储电短板。其通过多层硅与硅锗（SiGe）薄膜堆叠、刻蚀来制造；层数越高，互联结构越复杂，刻蚀难度越大。 SK 海力士提出选择器架构，只按需激活目标电路，可以缩减互联占用面积、降低电路负载；同时借鉴 3D NAND 的刻蚀整合工艺来控制制造成本。团队还在研究用铟镓锌氧化物（IGZO）替代硅做晶体管沟道材料，IGZO 漏电流更低，数据保存时间更长；当前难点是氢等因素会改变材料特性。崔康植表示，如果可靠性问题能够解决，IGZO 有望成为 3D DRAM 的颠覆性材料。
items.summary_en: ITHome Nov 25: According to The Elec, SK hynix senior engineer Choi Kang-sik said at the Seoul National University AI Semiconductor Forum that the company aims to mass-produce 3D DRAM within four to five years, and the first commercial product will use 100 vertically stacked memory cells. He said reaching density comparable to current 10nm-class DRAM requires about 75 layers of memory cells; considering other design factors, the first mass-production product was set directly at 100 layers. Existing equipment can support the 100-layer approach, but if the company later moves to 200 layers, 300 layers or higher stacking, it will need dedicated new equipment. In the long-term plan, SK hynix intends to draw on 3D NAND's multi-layer stacking and hybrid bonding technologies to target more than 1,000 layers. SK hynix has already completed fabrication of 3D DRAM memory-cell samples and verified device operating characteristics, with refresh performance comparable to conventional DRAM. 3D DRAM is a new architecture with vertically stacked memory cells, and is not the same as HBM (stacking multiple DRAM dies) or 3D stacking with DRAM on top of a logic chip. ITHome notes that traditional planar DRAM scaling is approaching physical limits: it stores charge via capacitors, and as cell size shrinks, storage capacity falls while leakage current and resistance rise. 3D DRAM no longer focuses solely on shrinking planar dimensions but uses vertical stacking to increase density and address the capacitor storage shortcoming. It is manufactured by stacking and etching multiple layers of silicon and silicon-germanium (SiGe) thin films; the higher the layer count, the more complex the interconnect structure and the harder the etching. SK hynix has proposed a selector architecture that activates target circuits only as needed, which can reduce interconnect area and circuit load; it also draws on 3D NAND etch-integration processes to control manufacturing costs. The team is also studying indium gallium zinc oxide (IGZO) to replace silicon as the transistor channel material; IGZO has lower leakage current and longer data retention. The current difficulty is that factors such as hydrogen can change the material's properties. Choi Kang-sik said that if reliability issues can be solved, IGZO is expected to become a disruptive material for 3D DRAM.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据 The Elec 报道，SK 海力士资深工程师崔康植（Choi Kang-sik）在首尔大学 AI 半导体论坛上透露，公司目标在 4 至 5 年内实现 3D DRAM 量产，首款商用产品将采用 100 层垂直堆叠存储单元。 他介绍，想要达到当前 10nm 级 DRAM 同等密度，大约需要 75 层存储单元；综合其他设计考量，第一款量产产品直接定为 100 层。现有设备可以支撑 100 层方案的制造，但如果后续要做到 200 层、300 层甚至更高堆叠，就需要专用新设备。长期规划上，SK 海力士计划借鉴 3D NAND 的多层堆叠与混合键合技术，冲击 1000 层以上。 目前 SK 海力士已经完成 3D DRAM 存储单元样片制造，并且验证了器件工作特性，刷新性能可以对标传统 DRAM。3D DRAM 是存储单元垂直堆叠的全新架构，和 HBM（多颗 DRAM 裸片堆叠）、DRAM 叠在逻辑芯片上的 3D 堆叠方案不是一回事。 据IT之家了解，传统平面 DRAM 微缩已经逼近物理瓶颈：依靠电容存电，单元尺寸越小，储电量越低、漏电流和电阻上升。3D DRAM 不再一味缩小平面尺寸，改用垂直堆叠提升密度，以此解决电容储电短板。其通过多层硅与硅锗（SiGe）薄膜堆叠、刻蚀来制造；层数越高，互联结构越复杂，刻蚀难度越大。 SK 海力士提出选择器架构，只按需激活目标电路，可以缩减互联占用面积、降低电路负载；同时借鉴 3D NAND 的刻蚀整合工艺来控制制造成本。团队还在研究用铟镓锌氧化物（IGZO）替代硅做晶体管沟道材料，IGZO 漏电流更低，数据保存时间更长；当前难点是氢等因素会改变材料特性。崔康植表示，如果可靠性问题能够解决，IGZO 有望成为 3D DRAM 的颠覆性材料。

items.title_zh: Counterpoint：预计 2027 年全球智能手机出货再降 6%，2028 年迎来首次反弹
items.title_en: Counterpoint: Global smartphone shipments expected to fall another 6% in 2027, with first rebound in 2028
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，Counterpoint Research 在最新《智能手机市场展望追踪报告》中预测， 2026 年全球智能手机出货量将同比下降 13.9% ，并在 2027 年进一步下滑 6%；随后市场有望在 2028 年反弹 6%。 本轮下行主要由元件成本飙升、低价机型供给收缩以及消费者购买力下降共同驱动。手机厂商普遍通过提价、降低内存配置、削减低毛利产品、收缩产品线、聚焦重点市场与机型来应对。高端需求相对有韧性，但难以抵消大众市场的萎缩。渠道与生产端表现也不均衡，部分地区开始出现库存偏低的情况；ODM / EMS 产能利用率显著下滑，多家主要供应商在安卓大厂砍单后主动缩减产能。 Counterpoint 首席分析师 Yang Wang 表示：“2026 年的下滑原本被认为是本轮周期的底部， 但内存形势比预期更紧张 。移动内存的分配仍在向 AI 与服务器需求倾斜，成本压力向机型组合与零售渠道传导也需要更长时间，导致 2027 年表现更弱，尤其是低价机型和价格敏感市场。” Counterpoint Research 市场展望 内存约束是 2027 年预期继续下调的主要原因 。移动 DRAM 分配持续偏紧，2027 年初 LPDDR 价格预计进一步上涨，而且在短期内，AI 与服务器等高价值应用并未明显增加面向智能手机行业的产能。元件成本上行同时挤压供给端与消费者购买力，OEM 减少低内存配置、抬高最低规格与零售价，砍掉不再盈利的机型，导致 200 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,336 元人民币） 以下机型市场不断收缩，且不断向该价位段的高端集中。一部分消费者会向上升级，但更多用户会推迟换机、延长换机周期或转向翻新机市场。 苹果与三星相对抗跌 。Counterpoint 预计苹果将在 2026 年和 2027 年继续以微弱领先保持全球出货量第一，其中 2026 年出货预计下滑 1%、2027 年下滑 4%；高端定位、分期金融、生态忠诚度以及更优先的供应商支持持续为苹果提供支撑，但提价以及 2025—2026 年换机高峰需求被透支，将限制出货涨幅。 三星 2026 年出货预计下滑 1%、2027 年下滑 3%，表现明显好于大盘；自研元件能力、完整产品线、长期运营商与零售关系，让三星在保障供应和渠道可得性上更具弹性，不过高端与折叠屏的预期增长难以抵消 Galaxy A 系列的走弱。 中国 OEM 将连续两年承压 。在 2026 年大幅收缩后，主流中国厂商预计 2027 年出货将继续下滑，在低价段与新兴市场的敞口更大，元件可得性下降和价格上涨会持续打击需求，各厂商大概率会进一步梳理产品线、退出盈利较弱的市场，财务纪律会变得更重要。 华为是 2026 年的主要例外，出货预计同比增长 12% ，依靠中国市场地位、国产元件能力以及海思持续取得的进展支撑；但在高定价和供应约束下，预计 2027 年会出现下滑。行业出清仍是 Counterpoint 的基准判断，中小厂商与边缘产品线面临最大风险。 Counterpoint 预计 2028 年全球智能手机出货将反弹 6% ，驱动力包括内存供应改善、元件价格企稳、同比基数降低以及 2026、2027 年被推迟的换机需求逐步回归。反弹力度取决于元件成本回落向零售价格传导的速度：如果 2027 年下半年移动内存分配改善更快，换机需求会被前置，2028 年预测存在上行空间；反之，AI 与服务器需求持续争夺产能、或手机价格再度上涨，则会限制复苏。 vivo、荣耀、OPPO 和小米有望在 2028 年实现更高增速 ，随着价格承受力改善和安卓换机需求回归，苹果与三星则因基数相对稳健，复苏幅度更温和。折叠屏、端侧 AI 和 AI 助理会继续支撑产品差异化、规格升级和 ASP，但不会形成一轮广泛的出货超级周期。6G 手机在本十年末逐步普及，会带来额外的升级动力，但到 2030 年，市场仍无法恢复到 2025 年的出货水平。
items.summary_en: Counterpoint Research forecast in its Smartphone Market Outlook Tracker that global smartphone shipments will fall 13.9% year over year in 2026, decline another 6% in 2027, and rebound 6% in 2028. The downturn is driven by surging component costs, shrinking supply of low-priced models, and weaker consumer purchasing power; vendors are responding with price increases, lower memory configurations, cuts to low-margin products, tighter product lines, and focus on key markets and models. High-end demand is relatively resilient but cannot offset the contraction in the mass market; channel and production performance is uneven, with low inventory in some regions, a marked drop in ODM/EMS utilization, and several major suppliers proactively cutting capacity after Android majors reduced orders. Counterpoint chief analyst Yang Wang said the 2026 decline had been seen as the cycle bottom, but memory conditions are tighter than expected: mobile memory allocation continues to favor AI and server demand, and cost pressure takes longer to pass through to model mix and retail channels, making 2027 weaker, especially for low-priced models and price-sensitive markets. The report says memory constraints are the main reason for the further cut to 2027: mobile DRAM allocation remains tight, LPDDR prices are expected to rise further in early 2027, and in the near term high-value applications such as AI and servers have not clearly added capacity for the smartphone industry. Rising component costs squeeze both supply and purchasing power; OEMs reduce low-memory configurations, raise minimum specs and retail prices, and cut unprofitable models, shrinking the sub-$200 segment and concentrating it toward the higher end of that price band. Some consumers upgrade, but more delay purchases, extend replacement cycles, or turn to refurbished phones. Counterpoint expects Apple to fall 1% in 2026 and 4% in 2027 while retaining a narrow global shipment lead, supported by premium positioning, installment finance, ecosystem loyalty, and prioritized supplier support. Samsung is expected to fall 1% in 2026 and 3% in 2027, outperforming the market. Chinese OEMs are expected to remain under pressure for two consecutive years, with further declines in 2027 after a sharp contraction in 2026. Huawei is the main exception in 2026, with shipments expected to grow 12%, but it is expected to decline in 2027 under high pricing and supply constraints. Industry consolidation remains Counterpoint's base case, with smaller vendors and edge product lines most at risk. Counterpoint expects global shipments to rebound 6% in 2028, driven by improved memory supply, stabilizing component prices, a lower year-over-year base, and the gradual return of deferred replacement demand from 2026-2027; the strength depends on how quickly cost declines pass through to retail prices. If mobile memory allocation improves faster in H2 2027, replacement demand could be pulled forward, creating upside to the 2028 forecast; conversely, continued AI/server competition for capacity or further phone price increases would limit recovery. vivo, Honor, OPPO, and Xiaomi are expected to grow faster in 2028, while Apple and Samsung recover more modestly due to relatively stable bases. Foldables, on-device AI, and AI assistants will continue to support differentiation, spec upgrades, and ASP, but will not create a broad shipment super-cycle; 6G phones will gradually spread toward the end of the decade, but by 2030 the market still will not return to 2025 shipment levels.

items.title_en: Avatr 06T Max Pioneer Edition launched: 896-line lidar, limited-time price 199,900 yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，阿维塔 06T Max 先锋版已上市，新车官方指导价为 21.99 万元，叠加限时权益后售价下探至 19.99 万元。新车定位中型纯电轿车，CLTC 工况纯电续航达 652 公里。作为车系新增版本，该车进一步拉低了阿维塔 06 的购入门槛。 IT之家注意到，阿维塔 06T Max 先锋版延续现款车型设计语言，采用低趴宽体车身姿态，配备标志性双层 LED 灯组，前包围两侧集成远近光灯组，并搭载主动式格栅。值得一提的是，该版本配备 896 线激光雷达，同步搭载华为乾崑 ADS 5 辅助驾驶系统，智能化配置向高阶版本看齐。 车身尺寸方面，新车长宽高分别为 4940/1960/1455 毫米，轴距 2940 毫米，配备 20 英寸五辐轮圈及马牌轮胎。车尾采用贯穿式尾灯设计，搭配车顶扰流板、撞色后包围及尾部扩散器装饰件，运动感十足。此外，新车标配车顶行李架，契合其旅行车定位。 内饰方面，阿维塔 06T Max 先锋版采用环拥式座舱布局，配备 35.4 英寸 4K 全景星环屏与 15.6 英寸悬浮中控屏，支持多屏信息交互。车机搭载鸿蒙座舱，内置 MoLA 大模型，具备 AI 车辆控制、全场景智能协同及语音交互能力，并配备 16 扬声器英国之宝音响。舒适性配置上，前排座椅提供加热、通风、按摩功能，储物空间方面提供 70 升前备厢与 517 升后备厢。 动力方面，新车搭载宁德时代 75.47 千瓦时电池包，采用双电机布局，电机总功率 450 千瓦，0-100 公里 / 小时加速仅需 3.74 秒，30%-80% 快充时间小于 10 分钟。
items.summary_en: The Avatr 06T Max Pioneer Edition has launched with an official guide price of 219,900 yuan, reduced to 199,900 yuan after limited-time benefits. It is positioned as a mid-size all-electric sedan with a CLTC range of 652 km and lowers the entry threshold for the Avatr 06 line. The new version continues the current design language, with a low, wide stance, signature dual-layer LED lamps, headlamp clusters in the front bumper sides, and an active grille. It features an 896-line lidar and Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 driver-assistance system, with intelligent features aligned with higher trims. Dimensions are 4,940/1,960/1,455 mm with a 2,940 mm wheelbase, 20-inch five-spoke wheels and Continental tires. The rear has a full-width taillight, roof spoiler, contrasting rear bumper and diffuser trim; roof rails are standard. Inside, it has a wrap-around cockpit, a 35.4-inch 4K panoramic ring screen and a 15.6-inch floating center screen with multi-screen interaction, HarmonyOS cockpit with the MoLA large model, AI vehicle control, all-scenario intelligent coordination and voice interaction, and 16-speaker Meridian audio. Front seats offer heating, ventilation and massage; storage includes a 70-liter frunk and 517-liter trunk. Power comes from a 75.47 kWh CATL battery, dual motors with 450 kW total output, 0-100 km/h in 3.74 seconds, and 30%-80% fast charging in under 10 minutes.
items.why_zh: 推测：该版本把高阶智驾硬件下放到更低价格，可能加剧20万元级纯电轿车竞争。
items.why_en: Speculation: by bringing high-end driver-assistance hardware to a lower price, this version could intensify competition in the 200,000-yuan-class EV sedan segment.

items.title_zh: 《燕云十六声》DLSS 5 体验：去除“网游味”，让武侠世界更拟真
items.title_en: Where Winds Meet DLSS 5 hands-on: shedding the 'online-game look' for a more realistic wuxia world
items.summary_zh: 英伟达的 DLSS 5 技术一经推出，便受到了广大玩家的追捧，不少民间大神将 DLSSNR 的 DLL 提取出来，做出了自制版的 DLSS 5“外挂”，玩家们研究发现一些游戏中自制版 DLSS 5 的效果很不错，甚至画面表现可以用惊艳来形容。 不过问题在于，没有 NVIDIA 和游戏官方的联合调校，玩家手搓参数的 DLSS 5 效果并不稳定，部分游戏调过了容易出现恐怖谷效应，而在优先考虑画质的前提下，性能帧数和游戏体验又难以兼顾。 因此，很多玩家都希望自己喜欢的游戏能够尽快适配 DLSS 5。出乎意料的是，2026 年 11 月 23 日，国产开放世界武侠动作 RPG 游戏《燕云十六声》首批适配了 DLSS 5 技术。相比传统的 3D 渲染管线，DLSS 5 引入了核心的“3D 引导神经网络渲染”技术，从根本上重塑了画面的渲染逻辑。它并非凭空生成画面，而是以游戏引擎已渲染的帧作为基础，通过 AI 精准识别场景中的材质、光源与物体，重建出更为真实的光照与材质细节。 这一过程不仅算力消耗极低，其 DLSS 超分辨率功能也可借助该神经网络进行渲染。最关键的是，它能在完全不改变原有美术设定的前提下，用 AI 补足因性能限制而缺失的画面细节，真正实现了“四两拨千斤”的画质飞跃。 作为一款有着在线模式和持续内容更新的网游，《燕云十六声》的游戏热度非常高，甚至在国外都火到破圈，其美术和画面表现力也十分出色，这让我们非常好奇，有了 DLSS 5 神经网络渲染的加持，《燕云十六声》的画面表现力更上一层楼？官方调校的 DLSS 5 是否也会有 AI 味？性能表现又能否让主流玩家接受？本期评测IT之家带你一探究竟。 一、测试平台 为了给玩家朋友们提供具有价值的性能参考，IT之家组建了一台基于 AMD 锐龙 7 9800X3D 处理器的七彩虹橘舍全家桶主机。 具体硬件配置如上图所示。 显卡方面，我们选用七彩虹 iGame RTX 5080 Vulcan OC、COLORFIRE RTX 5070 Ti 橘影橙 16G、COLORFIRE RTX 5070 橘影橙 12GB 三款显卡，在 2K 和 4K 分辨率下，对《燕云十六声》的 DLSS 5 画质和性能表现进行实测。 为了获得更好的游戏体验，我们采用了 26H2 最新版本的 Windows 11 系统。 显卡驱动上，本次测试基于 621.24 版本的 GeForce Game Ready 驱动程序，该驱动为《燕云十六声》的 DLSS 5 进行了专属适配优化。 二、画面效果 展现 DLSS 5 的游戏画面之前，首先我们来了解一下《燕云十六声》的 DLSS 5 部分的画质选项有哪些。 IT之家这次测试的是支持 DLSS 5 版本的《燕云十六声》先行体验版，进入游戏后画面设置中会增加一个神经渲染板块，玩家开启 DLSS 神经渲染功能后便顺利启用了 DLSS 5，该功能会从色调强度、结构强度和角色强度 3 个方面提升画质表现。 借助 GeForce RTX 50 显卡的强大算力，它可以支持自然的皮肤次表面散射效果、发丝与植被的真实透射效果，以及层次更丰富的接触阴影，并在建筑、室内外场景方面带来更真实的光照表现和材质效果。 DLSS 5 OFF DLSS 5 ON 先看室外的表现，打开 DLSS 5 之后画面的色彩饱和度和对比度降低了不少，更接近人眼在真实世界中看到的颜色。 左：DLSS 5 OFF，右：DLSS 5 ON 左：DLSS 5 OFF，右：DLSS 5 ON 同时，DLSS 5 还改善了原本浓郁色彩下，局部细节能见度低的问题。比如场景中左下角的草丛以及右上角的山体细节，关闭 DLSS 5 时原本的色调太过浓郁，反而让物体原本的细节发糊或者看不清。 左：DLSS 5 OFF，右：DLSS 5 ON 竹子的细节上，开启 DLSS 5 之后竹子的反光更加真实，竹子表面经过风雨洗礼留下的表皮剥落、发白等痕迹也栩栩如生。 DLSS 5 OFF DLSS 5 ON 另一组室外场景中，画面变化一眼就能察觉，除了对色彩表现的改善外，DLSS 5 对于建筑和路面细节的还原也更加真实。 左：DLSS 5 OFF，右：DLSS 5 ON 左：DLSS 5 OFF，右：DLSS 5 ON 该场景中，建筑材质细节更加丰富清晰、…
items.summary_en: According to the article, Nvidia's DLSS 5 has been popular with players since launch; some extracted the DLSSNR DLL to create homemade DLSS 5 'mods,' and players found the results good, even stunning, in some games. But without joint tuning by Nvidia and game developers, hand-tuned DLSS 5 is unstable: in some games over-tuning creates an uncanny-valley effect, and when image quality is prioritized, frame rates and gameplay experience are hard to balance. Many players therefore want their favorite games to support DLSS 5 soon. The article says that on November 23, 2026, the Chinese open-world wuxia action RPG Where Winds Meet was among the first to support DLSS 5. Compared with traditional 3D rendering pipelines, DLSS 5 introduces core '3D-guided neural rendering,' using frames already rendered by the game engine as a basis and using AI to identify materials, light sources and objects in the scene to reconstruct more realistic lighting and material details rather than generating images from nothing; the process is low in compute, DLSS super resolution can also use the neural network, and it can use AI to fill in details missing due to performance limits without changing the original art direction. The article says Where Winds Meet has an online mode and continuous content updates, is very popular and has broken out overseas, so it tested the official DLSS 5 tuning for image quality, 'AI look' and performance. The test platform used an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, with Colorful iGame RTX 5080 Vulcan OC, COLORFIRE RTX 5070 Ti Orange 16G and COLORFIRE RTX 5070 Orange 12GB graphics cards, at 2K and 4K, on Windows 11 26H2 with GeForce Game Ready driver 621.24. The preview build adds a neural rendering section in graphics settings; enabling it improves image quality through tone strength, structure strength and character strength, supporting natural skin subsurface scattering, realistic transmission for hair and vegetation, richer contact shadows, and more realistic lighting and materials in buildings and indoor/outdoor scenes. Comparisons show that with DLSS 5 on, outdoor color saturation and contrast are lower, closer to what the human eye sees, and visibility of local details under rich colors improves; bamboo reflections are more realistic and weathering marks such as peeling and whitening are more vivid; in another outdoor scene, building and road details are more realistically restored, and building material details are richer and clearer. The original text is truncated here.
items.why_zh: 推测：若官方调校的神经渲染能在低算力下稳定提升画质，可能推动更多在线游戏采用DLSS 5。
items.why_en: Speculation: if officially tuned neural rendering can stably improve image quality at low compute, it could encourage more online games to adopt DLSS 5.

items.title_zh: 设计时速 350 公里：济滨高铁试运行，山东最大地下高铁站同步测试
items.title_en: Designed for 350 km/h: Jinan-Binzhou high-speed railway enters trial operation, Shandong's largest underground high-speed rail station tested
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据央视新闻报道，11 月 25 日 8:30，55301 次试验动车组列车从济南东站平稳驶出，标志着新建天津至潍坊高速铁路济南联络线 —— 济滨高铁的联调联试圆满结束， 正式进入试运行阶段 ，全线开通运营进入倒计时。 济滨高铁自济南东站引出，终到滨州站，正线全长约 145.3 公里，设计时速 350 公里。 全线设济南东、遥墙机场、济阳、商河、惠民、滨州 6 座车站， 其中济南东站、滨州站为既有站，其余为新建站。 济滨高铁遥墙机场站建筑面积约 5.7 万平方米，站场规模 2 台 6 线， 是山东省台线规模最大的地下高铁站 。该站与沿途各站同步开展客运服务的全流程测试。 据介绍，遥墙机场站运用了自适应屏蔽门系统，在站台进站端通过 AI 识别摄像头，自主确定进站列车车型，在出站端用激光雷达确定车辆的精准停车位置，通过系统的计算， 在 1 秒钟之内确定列车开启车门的位置，屏蔽门利用轨道自主移动，能与列车门实现自动对正 。 IT之家获悉， 此次试运行将持续一个月左右 ，济滨高铁预计今年年底前具备开通运营条件。
items.summary_en: CCTV reported that at 8:30 on November 25, test EMU train 55301 departed Jinan East Station, marking the completion of joint commissioning and testing for the Jinan-Binzhou High-Speed Railway, the Jinan link of the new Tianjin-Weifang High-Speed Railway, and its formal entry into trial operation, with full-line opening in countdown. The line starts from Jinan East Station and ends at Binzhou Station, with a main line of about 145.3 km and a design speed of 350 km/h. It has six stations: Jinan East, Yaoqiang Airport, Jiyang, Shanghe, Huimin and Binzhou; Jinan East and Binzhou are existing stations, and the others are new. Yaoqiang Airport Station has a building area of about 57,000 square meters and a station layout of 2 platforms and 6 tracks, making it the underground high-speed rail station with the largest platform-track scale in Shandong; it is conducting full-process passenger service tests together with stations along the line. The station uses an adaptive platform screen door system: at the station entry end, AI recognition cameras independently determine the incoming train model; at the exit end, lidar determines the precise stopping position; through system calculation, the position for the train doors to open is determined within one second, and the screen doors move autonomously on tracks and automatically align with the train doors. The trial operation will last about one month, and the line is expected to be ready for opening by the end of this year.
items.why_zh: 推测：该项目将改善济南机场与鲁北地区的铁路连通，并为地下高铁站的智能屏蔽门提供示范。
items.why_en: Speculation: the project could improve rail links between Jinan airport and northern Shandong and serve as a demonstration for smart platform screen doors at underground high-speed rail stations.

items.title_zh: 华为陈海波：鸿蒙的初衷是万物智联，而非平替现有操作系统
items.title_en: Huawei's Chen Haibo: HarmonyOS was intended for ubiquitous intelligent connectivity, not to replace existing operating systems
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 25 日现场消息，在今天的 HarmonyOS 创新技术沟通会上，华为 Fellow、鸿蒙首席科学家陈海波登台发表了演讲。他也在现场宣布，鸿蒙终端设备数破亿， 跨越“梅特卡夫拐点”进入发展新阶段 。 IT之家注意到，在介绍完鸿蒙的发展情况后， 陈海波提及了鸿蒙的初衷是万物智联，而非平替现有操作系统 。他称，华为团队思考的是，如何为万物感知、万物互联和万物智能的未来设计全新操作系统。 陈海波表示，十多年前，华为围绕未来世界需要什么样的操作系统进行了洞察、分析。华为发现， 操作系统在发展过程中，实际上和信息产业是共生演进的，不同时期需要不同特质的操作系统 。而面向万物智联时代，华为认为操作系统需要实现两个统一： 第一个是大大小小的终端设备统一； 第二个是跨设备的应用生态统一。 同时，AI 在不断崛起，操作系统还需要服务好正在逐步形成的智能生态。
items.summary_en: At the HarmonyOS Innovation Technology Communication Meeting, Huawei Fellow and HarmonyOS chief scientist Chen Haibo gave a speech and announced that HarmonyOS terminal devices have exceeded 100 million, crossing the 'Metcalfe inflection point' into a new development stage. Chen said HarmonyOS's original intent is ubiquitous intelligent connectivity, not to replace existing operating systems. He said Huawei's team considered how to design a new operating system for a future of ubiquitous sensing, connectivity and intelligence. More than a decade ago, Huawei analyzed what kind of operating system the future world would need and found that operating systems co-evolve with the information industry, with different eras requiring operating systems with different traits. For the ubiquitous intelligent era, Huawei believes an operating system needs to achieve two unifications: first, unification of terminals of all sizes; second, unification of cross-device application ecosystems. At the same time, with AI rising, the operating system also needs to serve the emerging intelligent ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映鸿蒙的定位是面向多设备与AI的操作系统，而非单端替代，可能影响其生态叙事。
items.why_en: Speculation: this reflects HarmonyOS's positioning as an operating system for multiple devices and AI rather than a single-device replacement, which could shape its ecosystem narrative.
